name: bot.arbiterControl
why_off: Control path built, family list in bot.arbiterFamilies (default survive and player, bits 3). Wired families and their verdicts: survive+player (bits 1,2), chores+claim (bits 4,8; verdicts chores and claim pass offline, arbfam entry 1), goldfarm+recovery (bits 16,32; verdicts pass offline, arbfam entry 2), quest (bit 64; verdict passes offline, arbfam entry 3), level (bit 128; verdict passes offline, arbfam entry 4). Not run live; the outcome verdicts are a model of the monitor (U).
enable_criteria: Per family: d2scenario arbiter-replay verdict passes and the incident scenario rows green on a lockstep run, then flip on ONE sandbox with bot.arbiterShadow 1, 24 h invariant-monitor watch with automatic revert on a hard breach (docs/process/dark-launch.md), owner go per family
